phases.name: SVG Processing Pipeline
phases.description: Create preprocessing script and process all Hugeicons SVGs for theme compatibility

subtasks.title: Create SVG preprocessing script
subtasks.description: Build a Node.js script that reads SVGs from source, replaces hardcoded colors with CSS variables/currentColor, and outputs to destination directory
acceptance_criteria: Flattens category directories into single icons directory
subtasks.notes:
SVG preprocessing script (process-icons.cjs) is complete and committed. Features:
- Reads SVGs from .refs/icons/hugeicons/Duotone/ (3670 icons in 57 categories)
- Replaces fill="#D4D7E0" with fill="var(--icon-fill, currentColor)"
- Replaces stroke="#141B34" with stroke="currentColor"
- Flattens category directories into single output directory
- Supports mapping file (--mapping) or all icons (--all)
- Includes --dry-run and --verbose options
- Committed as 44b06cf

subtasks.title: Create icon mapping configuration
subtasks.description: Create a JSON file mapping Lucide icon names to their Hugeicons equivalents with exact filenames verified
acceptance_criteria: All 126 Lucide icons mapped to Hugeicons equivalents
Exact Hugeicons filenames verified against source
subtasks.notes: Created and validated icon-mapping.json with 125 Lucide to Hugeicons mappings. All filenames verified to exist in the Hugeicons Duotone source directory. Added validate-icon-mapping.cjs script for future verification.

subtasks.title: Process all required Hugeicons SVGs
subtasks.description: Run preprocessing script to copy and transform only the needed icons based on mapping
acceptance_criteria: All mapped icons processed and available
subtasks.notes:
Processed all 125 Hugeicons SVGs with complete color replacement:
- fill="#D4D7E0" -> fill="var(--icon-fill, currentColor)" for duotone background
- stroke="#141B34" -> stroke="currentColor" for stroke paths
- fill="#141B34" -> fill="currentColor" for solid fill paths

Added --icon-fill CSS variable to globals.css for all themes (light, dark, neutral, forest).

All icons now properly support theme switching. No hardcoded colors remain in the processed icons.

Committed as ca56eda.

subtasks.title: Add CSS variables for icon theming
subtasks.description: Add --icon-fill CSS variable to light and dark theme CSS for proper duotone effect
acceptance_criteria: Icons render with appropriate fill/stroke contrast
subtasks.notes:
Added --icon-fill CSS variable to all theme sections in globals.css:
- :root (light): #D4D7E0 (original Hugeicons duotone fill)
- .dark: #3A3A45 (muted dark gray for Oscura Midnight)
- dusk light/dark: #D4D7E0 / #3A3B42
- lime light/dark: #D4D7E0 / #3A3A50
- ocean light/dark: #BAE6FD / #164E63 (blue tones)
- retro light/dark: #FDE68A / #57534E (amber/stone)
- neo light/dark: #F0ABFC / #581C87 (pink/purple)
- forest light/dark: #86EFAC / #166534 (green tones)

This enables proper duotone effect where SVG fill uses var(--icon-fill, currentColor) for the background layer while stroke uses currentColor for the foreground layer.

Committed as bd36b33.
